title: telemetry-driven-release-notes-curator: synthesize concise rollups from model performance signals
author: Ava Martinez
release_notes:
- Introduces a new "telemetry curator" service that synthesizes concise release-note fragments from aggregated model telemetry (latency, error rate, eval regressions, cost delta).
- Adds opt-in model metadata fields for curated blurbs and telemetry signal annotations.
- Backwards compatible: curator is opt-in and only populates draft release snippets unless enabled in registry config.
description:
Motivation: writing accurate, prioritized release notes for model updates is time-consuming and often misses operational signals. This PR adds a telemetry-driven curator that ingests model telemetry and auto-synthesizes concise, ranked release-note fragments for model onboarding and version rollouts.

What this changes (summary): implemented a lightweight curator microservice and registry hook that: (1) consumes time-windowed model telemetry (p95 latency, p99, error rate, eval delta, token-cost changes) from the telemetry store, (2) computes an impact score per signal using a configurable weighting profile, (3) synthesizes short human-readable fragments (1-2 sentences) with signal context and suggested severity tags, (4) attaches fragments to model-version draft release notes and ranks them by impact so SRE/product can triage.

Design notes: the curator uses a deterministic scoring heuristic (configurable in registry config) rather than a heavy generative model for initial rollout—this keeps outputs auditable. We provide a preview CLI (registry-cli curator preview) and a web preview in the model registry UI. The curator is opt-in at the model or org level via metadata flag registry.config.curator.enabled (defaults to false). For private deployments the telemetry ingestion runs over local telemetry endpoints only; no telemetry is sent to hosted services.

Files changed (high level): added src/curator/service.py (core scoring + synth tie-in), src/curator/adapter_prometheus.py (telemetry pulls), registry/schema/model_metadata_v3.json (new optional fields: curator_enabled, telemetry_hints, release_blurb_drafts), cli/registry_cli/curator.py (preview tool), docs/operational/release-curator.md (runbook + config), tests/curator/test_scoring.py, tests/curator/test_integration_e2e.py, examples/onboard/curator-preview.yml, infra/helm/curator-chart.yaml, migration/0007-add-curator-metadata.sql.

Commits (high-level):
- 3f4b9d2 initial curator prototype: scoring engine + simple templates
- a9e1b7f add prometheus adapter + time-windowed pulls
- d2a4c62 add CLI preview + registry API hook for draft fragments
- f9b0c3a add schema migration and metadata docs
- 1c0e5d1 tests: scoring unit tests + e2e with sample telemetry blob
- b6f7d8a polish: handle missing telemetry gracefully, add opt-in flag, update docs and examples

Review conversation (condensed):
- Rohit Singh (review): "Nice approach keeping the initial version deterministic. Two asks: add a clear audit trail for curator decisions, and ensure we never auto-publish notes without explicit opt-in. Also please name the severity taxonomy in the schema."
- Author (Ava): "Addressed: curator now records 'decision_reason' entries (scoring vector) per fragment in registry change log; curator respects model-level curator_enabled and org-level opt-in. Added severity taxonomy enum to model_metadata_v3.json and docs."
- Claire O'Neil (review): "Can we expose the raw signals in preview and add an option to surface the top-3 contributing signals?"
- Author: "Added top_contributors field in preview output and UI snippet; updated CLI and e2e tests to assert presence."
- Diego Rivera (security review): "Confirm that telemetry never leaves private deployment boundaries and that we enforce KMS usage for any persisted curator artifacts."
- Author: "Curator persists artifacts to the same registry blob store and respects existing KMS configs; note included in runbook and helm chart values."

Requested changes and resolution: all requested changes were addressed across commits b6f7d8a and subsequent polish commits. Unit tests and e2e test were added for the preview flow and migration.

CI summary: initial CI run flagged lint errors (flake8) and a transient e2e failure in the integration job. Fixes committed (style and a test timeout bump). Final CI: all checks passed (unit, lint, integration, helm chart lint).

Testing and rollout plan: curator is feature-flagged. We'll enable in staging orgs and run the preview against a set of historical telemetry windows to validate fragment relevance. Observability: added curator-specific metrics (curator.fragments.generated, curator.score.histogram, curator.preview_latency) and dashboard panel in docs to watch production behavior.

Backward compatibility and migration: schema migration 0007 is additive and optional; existing models without curator fields keep same behavior. The migration script is idempotent and covered by tests.

Security/Privacy: by default curator disabled. For private installs nothing is shipped off-cluster; helm chart exposes curator.enabled and curator.ingestEndpoint. Artifacts are stored encrypted when KMS present.

Open items / follow-ups:
- ENG-1427: explore an alternative generative refinement step for higher-signal blurbs (out of scope for this PR).
- PM-587: add UX affordances for editing curated fragments before release (scheduled).
